title: Interior finish and perceived quality
summary: Feedback on the F70 interior centers on a generally favorable impression of finish and quality, with many fragments too brief or ambiguous to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the interior for looking good and feeling high quality or well finished.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on disappointing finish quality, cheap-feeling plastic trim, and missing rear-seat comfort features mentioned alongside interior criticism.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the interior or its quality cues but are too brief or unclear to confirm a sentiment consistently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are very short or vague, which limits confidence in interpreting the overall tone of interior comments.
The negative sample is small, so the specific complaints should be treated as examples rather than a complete list.
Some fragments combine interior finish with equipment or comfort items, which broadens the topic beyond material quality alone.
